_README: Every human judgement about this ROM lives in this file; the
generated listings are disposable, so renaming is free.
What to do next, roughly in order:
Read the coverage it reports. Low coverage is normal at
first and is the number you are trying to move.
2. Every unresolved indirect jump it reports is a hole. Add the
target to `entries`, or the pointer pair to `ram_vectors` if
the handler is installed into RAM.
Finds the sound code and the tables feeding it.
4. Name things in `labels` as soon as you know what they are.
See docs/method.md for the working order and docs/pitfalls.md for
the traps that each cost real time.

comments.f0:60A0: NMI entry. CLI, then JMP ($DD): every DLI handler arms the next by storing its address in $DD/$DE. (live: J lines in runs/ab/xt1/exectrace.log)
comments.f0:60B6: Top-of-frame DLI (raster 16, live). Arms Dli_HudEnd, pages in bank 6 (HUD art and code), sets CHARBASE $B0 / CTRL $40, calls b6:8003 (palette upload, HUD and score upkeep), then SPINS INSIDE THE NMI at $60D2 until the nested DLI at the HUD's foot sets $FE; only then pages the level bank back (raster 81, live) and jumps to its $B000. The main program gets no CPU for those 65 lines.
comments.f0:6FA0: One game tick: gated by INTIM < $2102 (RIOT T1024T reloaded with $FF each tick), then level tick (level bank $B003), scroll every $2104 ticks, player/cursor, object scripts every $2103 ticks, and the display-list build, which itself waits for the last flip.
comments.f0:46B0: Pending-spawn queue ($1EB8.., count $211B, max 29). Speed byte $FF = remove every object of that type; else SpawnObject with the queued position, speed, script offset and loop count. Objects that cross a 16-line row are re-entered through this queue.
comments.f8:F56B: Display-list builder. One pass over the draw list ($227D type / $22FF slot, at most $82 entries): $FF ends a zone's list (two zero bytes, next DLL pointer), $FE emits the zone's tile row (5-byte indirect header), anything else emits a 4-byte header [script+1, script+0, script+2 + (y & 15) - (flags & $7F), x]. No sort, no zone lookup, no cap per zone. Verified live: 16,465 builds on five levels, all byte-exact against this reading (tools/abmodel.lua).
comments.f8:F687: Spawn type X at ($FA,$F8). For each of the type's 1-3 cells: a slot with flags $80 in the row of y, and (unless the type's zone flags say one zone is enough) a second slot with flags $90 in the row below. Each slot gets the cell's script pointer; the first slot gets the hit points.
comments.f8:F8C2: Insert into the draw list: skip to the zone's bucket (count $FF ends), then before the first entry of a higher class (type flags >> 4; the tile row's class is TileRowClass[row]) or of the same class and a larger y. The arrays above are shifted up by one. Returns the first free slot (flags bit 7 clear) in Y.
comments.f8:FA44: Object update: for every draw-list entry, a speed divider ($2683 low nibble = period, high = count), then one script step. A frame record is 5 bytes [palette/width, gfx lo, gfx hi, dx, dy]; dx/dy are applied when the frame is left. If y's row changes the object is removed and queued for respawn at its new row.
comments.f8:FBFE: Script commands (first byte < $10): 00/01 skip (01 01 marks a loop start), 02 loop to mark, 03 n repeat n times, 04 restart, 05 k v effect (0 hurt player, 1 sound, 2 blast at position, 3 score), 06 n set loop count, 07 n / 08 n raise / clear event counter n, 09 t remove all of type t, 0A d cell x offset, 0B i n skip n bytes if random AND mask[i], 0C t dx dy s spawn child, 0D t dx dy s become type t, 0E/0F remove self.
comments.f8:F24A: Hit test of the cursor (or a blast) against every draw-list entry whose type has a death type ($D500) and whose slot holds hit points: box = TypeHitWidth*4 px by cells*16 lines, widened by four slop bytes at $1F6C. Damage 1, 8 or 16*n by weapon; at zero the object is removed and its death type spawned at ($D300,$D400) offsets, then the $D600 chain.
comments.f8:F3FE: Scroll script: every 80 scroll ticks the next byte of the level bank's $B010 table becomes the scroll step ($00 stop, $01 right, $FF left, $10 start, $20 hold until event counter 3 clears, $80 end of level). Verified live on level 1 (runs/ab/tick).
comments.b1:B6BF: Level 1's spawner: hand-written code, not a table. Five countdown timers ($2122-$2126) each pick among spawn routines with the random generator, gated on the scroll position $2100; speeds come from $2135-$2138 and toughness masks from $212F (set per skill by b3:9E74).
